sources.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 Security Technical Implementation Guide

sources.notes: Applies to the host and to the UBI 9 filesystem. Most of its rules are host-owned rather than image-owned, which the origination property records per control.

sources.title: Container Platform Security Requirements Guide
sources.license: US Government work; redistribution terms stated in the package
sources.notes: Officially released as V2R1 on 2024-07-24, and the filename follows DISA's published convention as U_Container_Platform_V2R1_SRG.zip, but it is no longer served from the public download path: that URL returns 404 while U_Web_Server_V3R3_SRG.zip returns 200 from the same directory, so the path and method are sound and the file is not there. The download index cannot be used to locate it either; it is now a JavaScript-rendered portal whose HTML contains no download links, so it cannot be resolved programmatically. Retrieval needs a browser session or the SRG-STIG library compilation. Blocking for the container-platform cross-reference only; the spine does not depend on it.

sources.title: Application Server Security Requirements Guide
sources.license: US Government work; redistribution terms stated in the package
sources.notes: Retrieved and pinned, then assessed as not applicable to this component; see docs/adr/0010-application-server-srg-not-applicable.md. Of its 137 rules, 27 presuppose a management interface or hosted applications and 18 refer to accounts. This image has no management interface, no accounts, and hosts no application, so those rules govern objects that do not exist here; the remainder are stated for a component of this kind by the Web Server SRG, which is the applicable DISA cross-reference. Pinned rather than dropped so the determination is tied to the revision it was made against.

sources.title: CIS Benchmark, applicable target to be selected
sources.license: CIS Securesuite / CIS Benchmark terms; redistribution restricted
sources.notes: Retrieval requires an authenticated CIS Workbench account; the public URL redirects to a login. The benchmark text also may not be redistributed, so it can be cited by identifier but its content cannot be vendored or quoted at length. Pinning by digest requires an account holder to retrieve it and record the digest here.
